organization: Illinois General Assembly (statute text via PocketLaw mirror)
title: Companion Animal Cremation Act, 815 ILCS 318
claim: Illinois pet cremation providers must publish a written explanation of services (no misleading 'private/individual' claims), give it to referring vets, and certify returned remains; violations are business offenses ($1,001-$1,500 first; $2,000-$2,500 subsequent).
